instruction.text: Select the different foods that the Maya grew.

feedback.finish: The Maya grew lots of different crops to eat and trade, such as maize, squash and beans. They also gathered food like chillies.

atoms.b: The Maya were excellent ((++farmers swimmers)) because they studied the stars and ((++weather clothing)) patterns.
They were able to create detailed ((++calendars poems)) telling them which types of ((++crops rocks)) to plant at certain times of the year, and when they should be harvested.

feedback.finish: Terrace farming was a method used by the Maya in mountainous regions to increase the amount of farmland. Steps were built into the hill so that crops could be planted all the way up.

atoms.b: Another farming method used by the Maya is called raised field. This was used in areas that were very ((++wet dry)).
Small ((++islands puddles)) were created by digging soil from beneath the water and piling it up. In between the islands, water would flow through, creating canals.
Farmers could then use the canals to ((++fish snorkel)) and the islands to plant crops.

instruction.text: Drag the axe to the forest.

feedback.finish: The last of the three main farming techniques used by the Maya is called slash and burn. This involves cutting down and burning areas of forest to use for farming.
